title: Strategy Inc. (MSTR) — Comprehensive Investment Monograph
target_base_method: Analyst scenario, not consensus: static capital claims and approximate shares; BTC +15% over twelve months; exit enterprise-value-to-BTC ratio 1.05x; excludes software value and future issuance.
target_bull_method: Analyst scenario, not forecast: BTC +50%; exit enterprise-value-to-BTC ratio 1.20x; same capital claims and basic-equivalent share estimate.
target_bear_method: Analyst stress case, not forecast: BTC −50%; exit enterprise-value-to-BTC ratio 0.80x; same capital claims and basic-equivalent share estimate.
holding_rationale: The ledger confirms 21.414 direct MSTR shares in Schwab, worth $2,449.98 at the November 12 close, against $2,699.99 cost and a $250.01 unrealized loss. The position is 2.70% of net worth; the linked MSTX holding raises combined MSTR-related exposure to 4.21%. The model values MSTR at $108.12, below the $114.41 close, while the $79 invalidation is 31% below that close. Exit the direct shares at the next available execution opportunity; re-underwrite MSTX separately. This is advisory, not a broker order.

holding_alerts.trigger: Next available execution opportunity at prevailing market conditions
holding_alerts.instruction: Exit all 21.414 direct MSTR shares. The November 12 reference value is $2,449.98; actual proceeds depend on execution. Review the separate MSTX holding independently. This is advisory, not a broker order.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Anticipated proceeds from exiting 21.414 direct MSTR shares (November 12 reference value $2,449.98; actual proceeds depend on execution), plus the next marginal US cash unit

destinations.recommendation: Retain all direct-MSTR exit proceeds and the next marginal dollar in cash.
destinations.rationale: The probability-weighted MSTR value is below the November 12 close, the stock has no confirmed base, the broad market is in Correction, and correlated MSTX exposure remains for separate review.
destinations.entry_condition: Reassess after the broad-market regime stabilizes and a current equity setup clears business, valuation, and trend gates.

destinations.recommendation: Retain AVPT as the active-shortlist comparator; no capital is allocated by this dossier.
destinations.rationale: AVPT is on the copied active US shortlist and the November 12 facts ledger classifies it as Stage 2, but the user's broader high-beta portfolio and the market correction argue against adding risk from an MSTR-only review.
destinations.entry_condition: Require a separate same-session AVPT review, continued Stage 2 structure, and its operating/valuation gates before allocating.

destinations.recommendation: Use IBIT only as a comparison vehicle for direct Bitcoin exposure; no capital is allocated now.
destinations.rationale: IBIT removes MSTR-specific equity issuance and preferred-stock mechanics and had a November 12 NAV of $40.4352, closing price $40.36, and a 0.25% sponsor fee. It still has Bitcoin price risk, no operating cash yield, and is not a substitute for a diversified cash reserve.
destinations.entry_condition: A hypothetical base uses BTC +15% less the 0.25% annual sponsor fee; review only after Bitcoin and broad-market trends stabilize and a fresh same-session snapshot confirms the $34–$36 support review band.

short_term_outlook: Stay out at the current close: MSTR is below its 20/50/200-day averages, the multi-timeframe snapshot calls the structure Stage 4, and no options edge is present. Reconsider only after a base and trend reclaim.
medium_term_outlook: Watch cloud-subscription retention and software cash conversion alongside USD-reserve coverage, preferred dividend burden, share issuance, and BTC Yield. A continuing negative per-share yield would weaken the core capital-markets thesis.
long_term_outlook: Conditional on Bitcoin appreciation and the ability to grow Bitcoin per share without persistent dilution, while the software operation improves its cash contribution. The current evidence does not establish a durable compounder profile.

Market-data timing exception: market_facts and positions use the verified November 12 close. Stock/options snapshots were retrieved during the November 13 session; close and technical statements in the report use the November 12 ledger, while later chart/option readings are explicitly identified as post-cutoff context.

Technical-classification conflict: the November 12 facts ledger labels MSTR Stage 1 (Basing), while stock_snapshot and the multi-timeframe options/chart read label the structure Stage 4/below trend. The report discloses the conflict and bases its no-entry posture on the underlying price/average/volume evidence rather than silently selecting a bullish label.

Holdings freshness: market_facts reported ACA in stale_vs_asof and was run with --allow-stale-holdings. Schwab's copied transaction log last records a transaction on November 10 and Robinhood's on November 12; the ledger treats broker transaction logs as authoritative for executed holdings. MSTR itself was priced at the November 12 close.

Browser probe exception: the options helper could not read a Robinhood session because its Chrome bridge lacked eval_js, so it used the public options chain. A separate read-only Chrome inspection confirmed TradingView access and manually checked visible 1D/1W MSTR charts; the 4H reading came from the public multi-timeframe snapshot.

Reviewer-model exception: the configured reviewer model ao-claude-lc/claude-sonnet-5-5 and red-team model ao-foundry-lc/gpt-6.1-sol were unavailable in this harness (the runner returned “Model is not available”). Both independent passes were completed in separate sessions by the default Azure gpt-6-luna agent. Using the same model family reduces model diversity and lowers confidence in the independent judgment; cure by rerunning the review with the configured routes if they become available before the next dossier refresh.

Review-limit exception: the final independent reviewer returned REVISE in Round 2. Its findings on the selected $79 weekly-close invalidation wording, the executive first-person aside, and duplicate punctuation were corrected after that round. No third review was run because the two-round cap is strict. The post-round corrections have not received another independent review; the dossier is best effort and is not reviewer-approved. Recheck these edits in the next dossier refresh.
